name: 「給料が上がると、性格も変わる?」(再制作版・最新仕様)

p_39dfde4eeb.sentence: The arrows linking higher income to later personality changes point in different directions, depending on the trait.
p_39dfde4eeb.prev: But studies of income and personality do not support a cheer for “all numbers up!”
p_39dfde4eeb.next: First, here is a result you may hope for.

p_bef511aa85.sentence: You look at your paycheck and cannot help smiling.
p_bef511aa85.prev: The Surprising Split Between Money and Personality
p_bef511aa85.next: You feel more at ease, and work and relationships are going well.

p_07ed712929.sentence: You feel more at ease, and work and relationships are going well.
p_07ed712929.prev: You look at your paycheck and cannot help smiling.
p_07ed712929.next: If your personality improved too, life would get much better.

p_5530f89100.sentence: The researchers looked at changes in the same people.
p_5530f89100.prev: First, here is a result you may hope for.
p_5530f89100.next: When income rose, conscientiousness later rose a little too.

p_16467d5741.sentence: This means being willing to work with others.
p_16467d5741.prev: Higher income had a small link with later drops in agreeableness.
p_16467d5741.next: It also had a small link with later drops in extraversion.

p_8108f17481.sentence: Doing things properly” and “getting along well with people” both sound like good things.
p_8108f17481.prev: This means being outgoing and active with people.
p_8108f17481.next: But their links with rising income went in opposite directions.

p_eeeb4fba0b.sentence: But their links with rising income went in opposite directions.
p_eeeb4fba0b.prev: Doing things properly” and “getting along well with people” both sound like good things.
p_eeeb4fba0b.next: If we say, “Their personality got better,” we miss too much.

p_352c9b6579.sentence: On average, researchers found no clear link between income changes and later changes in openness.
p_352c9b6579.prev: What about openness, or interest in new things?
p_352c9b6579.next: Not every part of personality changes in the same way when income rises.

p_319abf5980.sentence: Instead of asking, “Does more money make you a good person?”, we can ask a more interesting question.
p_319abf5980.prev: The point is that the links are small and point in different directions.
p_319abf5980.next: Which parts of personality are linked to income, and which way do they go?

p_2cb613ee55.sentence: The largest estimates, measured on the same scale, were 0.0630 for conscientiousness and −0.0096 for agreeableness.
p_2cb613ee55.prev: Also, we may get excited about which way the arrows point and forget how small the numbers are.

p_d647066df6.sentence: What about openness, or interest in new things?
p_d647066df6.prev: They show only small links, and the links differ by trait.
p_d647066df6.next: On average, researchers found no clear link between income changes and later changes in openness.

p_e70647c646.sentence: Emotional stability also showed a small later rise.
